'''Kendruh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]-based [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. An overseer for the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]], he kept records of the slaves' families to punish them in case the slaves rebelled and escaped. In [[3637 BBY]] an individual incited a rebellion among the slaves kept by Nova Blades on a remote island and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Kendruh to persuade the slaves join the rebellion in full force.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slavemaster Kendruh appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released in [[2014]], to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
